Tam e7walna lal far2 men DawaLink, w 3am kammel el bahs 3an Augmentin 1g. La2ad ma3 kel el ma3loumet, 2ara shu bade:
1) Ma fi wa7de men 3am tebḥa 3ala min? (2arib men el beit, aw bi manta2a ma3ayyane, aw ayy manta2a)
2) Qaddet kam yom bde tekhod el dawa? (Ma ba3ref, ayya yom ba2at)
3) Imta bde tjiblon? (Lyom, bukra, aw ayy yom)

Ayya jawab bi ba3ref aw ayy manta2a ba2at.
